title: Sale in a wallet user interface
scope: e2e/wallet-ui/ sells 1 USDT or 0.0001 ETH on Sepolia from the patched starter wallet. The runner reads the sandbox transaction list [ref 0] and keeps the row whose inputTxId is that hash [ref 1]. It does not send the hash in that request. The chain transfer, the wallet send and that sandbox recognition are executed. The entries are the stand-ins around them.

entries.status: fake — patched starter, not the released wallet
entries.mechanism: [ref 0] points Ethereum at @tetherto/wdk-wallet-evm instead of @tetherto/wdk-wallet-evm-7702-gasless. [ref 1] removes the Ethereum bundler and paymaster URLs. [ref 2] adds Sell. [ref 3] opens the sell page in a WebView and does not inject a provider. [ref 4] shows an Ethereum token fee in ETH and does not add it to the token total. [ref 5] adds the confirm test id on the send review button. [ref 6] adds Sell ETH.
entries.insteadOf: the unmodified released WDK starter wallet, with Ethereum on the gasless package
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove the sale in an unpatched or released wallet.

anchor: + * Ethereum is a plain account: a token send's quoted fee is wei, shown in
+ * ETH, and is not added to the token total. A native ETH send's fee is in
+ * ETH and is part of the total. Bitcoin shows its quoted network fee in
+ * BTC, since Bitcoin has no sponsorship at all.
+        <Button testID="send-confirm" label="Confirm" onPress={onConfirm} loading={isSending} disabled={isQuoting || isSending} />

entries.mechanism: [ref 0] requires Maestro 2.10. [ref 1] starts maestro test against the booted simulator.
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that a person can complete the sale without these scripted taps.

anchor: if (!/^2\.10\.\d+$/.test(maestroVersion)) throw new NotRunError(`not run: maestro 2.10 is required, found ${maestroVersion}`)

entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove the sale on a physical device.

anchor: if (runtime !== 'com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimRuntime.iOS-26-5') throw new NotRunError(`not run: the simulator runtime is ${runtime}; this run needs iOS 26.5`)

entries.mechanism: [ref 0] reads https://dev.api.dfx.swiss. [ref 1] binds the starter's DFX protocol to environment sandbox.
entries.insteadOf: the production DFX API at https://api.dfx.swiss
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that production recognizes the deposit or books the sale.

entries.status: fake — invented per run, a placeholder that looks real
entries.mechanism: [ref 0] builds a Swiss IBAN. The BBAN starts with clearing 00000 and twelve random digits, and the two check digits are 98 minus the mod-97 remainder of the BBAN followed by 121700.
entries.insteadOf: an IBAN of a bank account the seller holds
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that a bank would accept this number or pay the sale to an account the seller holds.

entries.status: switched off — the runner stops at PayoutInProgress or Completed
entries.mechanism: [ref 0] checks the booked payout and returns when the sandbox row is PayoutInProgress or Completed. The runner does not read a bank debit.
entries.insteadOf: a bank transfer of the fiat amount to the payout account
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that a bank paid the fiat amount.
